name: Nasutoceratops
sum: Nasutoceratops is a large-nosed, long-horned centrosaurine from the Campanian Kaiparowits Formation of Utah.
wsnote: Estimates for the subadult holotype in the cited Wikipedia revision; holotype skull about 1.5 m long.
holotype: A subadult skull with partial postcranial skeleton and skin impressions (collection number not given in the sources used) — Kaiparowits Formation, Grand Staircase–Escalante National Monument, Utah.
material: Two other partial skulls from the same formation.
exceptional: Rare skin impressions with the holotype.
biology: Long, outward-curving brow horns and a short nasal region; member of the Nasutoceratopsini tribe (Sampson et al. 2013).
author: Sampson et al. 2013
